mapper.select: SELECT assignment.id AS assignment_id, assignment.current_status, assignment.version_no FROM learn_task_assignment assignment JOIN edu_student_organization class_relation ON class_relation.student_id = assignment.student_id AND class_relation.organization_id = #{classOrganizationId} AND class_relation.relation_type = 'CLASS' AND class_relation.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE assignment.source_type IN ('ORGANIZATION', 'TEACHER') AND assignment.current_status IN ( 'PENDING_CLAIM', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'PENDING_REVIEW', 'NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT' ) ORDER BY assignment.id FOR UPDATE
